name: C&A Modas S.A.
summary: C&A Modas S.A. operates as a fashion retailer for women, men, and children in Brazil and internationally. It offers blouses, pants, dresses, skirts, coats, beachwear, underwear, t-shirts, shirts, Bermuda, jackets and coats, bodies, sets, and shorts; beauty products, including perfumes, makeup, skincare, body and bath, and accessories; and footwear, such as boots, shoes and loafers, flats, sandals, papetes, and tennis footwear. The company sells its products through stores, as well as online. The company was founded in 1841 and is headquartered in Barueri, Brazil.
